scope: Bounded synthetic JSON Schema witness comparison of dirty local main and M2 catalogs
validator: Ajv 8.20.0; strict and format validation disabled
method: Generated bounded synthetic objects using required properties, optional properties one at a time, oneOf/anyOf variants, enum/const values, basic scalar boundaries and limited recursive array examples. Both schemas were independently compiled and only main-valid witnesses were compared.
limitations: Generated examples are finite and do not exhaust combinations, formats, all constraints or alternate branches; validation formats were disabled.
This only compares declared input schema behavior for synthetic requests; it does not verify runtime validation, defaults, output, actual GUI/MCP parity, or native behavior.
Dirty main can change; rerun before integration.
